simple.text: **Aspect of the Beast** 10 s before the pull.
**Move to 11 yd** 5 s before the pull.
**Aimed Shot** 2 s before the pull, from 11 yd.
**Demonic Rune** when {Missing mana} or more mana is missing.
**Major Mana Potion** when {Missing mana} or more mana is missing.
**Rapid Fire** at the pull, or from 5 s into the fight with Summon Hawk or Bestial Wrath.
**Any other cooldown** when ready (Bestial Wrath, Intimidation, trinkets).
**Hunter's Mark** when it is not on the target (you are the raid's only hunter).
**Serpent Sting** when it has {Refresh at} s or less left.
**Queue Raptor Strike** after your last shot before you step in: any shot, your Auto Shot too, cancels it.
**Move in** to {Melee spot} yd after your Auto Shot once your MH swing timer is at 1.5 s or less, unless Multi-Shot is ready within 0.2 s (shoot it first).
**Immolation Trap** within 6 yd of the target.

texts.text: **Wing Clip** as you move out, unless Arcane Shot or Multi-Shot is ready.

simple.text: **Move out** to {Ranged spot} yd as soon as your MH swing lands, unless your first Strider Kick, Mongoose Bite or Immolation Trap this trip is waiting on your global cooldown and your next Auto Shot is still 1.6 s or more away.

texts.when: Off hand swing > 0 and Weave play >= 2
texts.text: **Move out** to {Ranged spot} yd as soon as your MH swing lands.
**Move out** to {Ranged spot} yd as soon as your MH swing lands, unless an OH swing lands within 0.8 s.

texts.when: Main hand swing - Auto Shot swing >= 0.5
texts.text: **Move out** to {Ranged spot} yd as soon as your MH swing lands, unless your first Strider Kick, Mongoose Bite or Immolation Trap this trip comes up within a second of your global cooldown coming back.
